name: Magic UI
summary: 150+ free animated React components for shadcn/ui (Tailwind + Motion).
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free registry UI components of ~78 registry:ui items; not a full inventory.
Pro templates/sections at pro.magicui.design are excluded (proOnly / not unlocked).
Library adapter prefers dynamic-import per ARCHITECTURE §5 but component demos use iframe→docs until Build smoke-certifies dynamic-import mounts.
Official docs often show `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @magicui/...`; catalog uses portable `npx shadcn@latest` equivalent from same docs/MDX.

components.name: Marquee
components.summary: Infinite scrolling strip for text, images, or videos.
components.copyCode: npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/marquee import { Marquee } from "@/components/ui/marquee" Next.js React TypeScript Tailwind CSS

copyPrompt.text: Use Magic UI free component `Marquee` (slug `marquee`) from https://magicui.design/docs/components/marquee. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/marquee` after `npx shadcn@latest init` in a React/Next + Tailwind project (same flow as shadcn/ui). Registry item: https://magicui.design/r/marquee.json. Import from `@/components/ui/marquee` after CLI add (path may follow project aliases). This component is on the free open-source registry (MIT); do not pull Magic UI Pro templates/sections from pro.magicui.design unless the user has Pro. Requires React + Tailwind; many items also need `motion` (and globe needs `cobe`). Prefer free-tier only.
